QuestInfo.name: JM's Conspiracy Theory
QuestInfo.0: #b#p1052002# in #m103000000##k is looking for someone to help him uncover a #rconspiracy#k...
QuestInfo.1: JM says that a #r#o6220000##k has appeared in #m103000000#'s sewers. He thinks there's a conspiracy to destroy Kerning City from below! The first thing you must do is ask #b#p9000008##k for information.
QuestInfo.2: According to #p9000008#, #o6220000# is like a #o3110100#, but bigger and with magic.

0.0: ...Hush. Keep your voice down. You never know who's hiding nearby... Are you determined to get to the bottom of the rumor you heard? Is that why you're here? You seem like an adventurer... yet a weak, scrawny one. It won't be that easy. You want to know what it is?
0.1: You've probably heard about the swamp region past the sewer system? That's where ferocious alligators live. But monsters have been making frequent appearances as of late. The people of Kerning City are shivering in fear because of Dyle and its vast mouth furnished with sharp teeth...
0.2: But isn't it a little strange? Where did Dyle come from? How did it get to the sewer system? Could it be that someone released it into the sewer? In order to put Kerning City in danger! It can be a malicious scheme!

yes.0: The test is simple. All you have to do is to prove that you know the swamp. Once you get to the swamp, hunt Ligators and Crocos, then bring back 50 skins from each. Show me your abilities!

no.0: I guess you're not too confident in yourself. I told you it was too much for you to handle.

0.0: Sh! Keep your voice down! I got an important mission for you this time, but keep it on the down-low...
0.1: You know the Swamp Region outside #m103000000#, right? Filled with all those nasty alligators? Well, a new monster's showed up there lately: a #r#o6220000#'#k, with a huge mouth and sharp fangs...
0.2: But where did this #o6220000# come from? What's it doing in so close to the city? Don't you think there's something fishy here?
0.3: I want you to snoop around, see if you can uncover who's behind this conspiracy!

yes.0: We need to figure out what's going on. Start with #b#p9000008##k. See what he knows about Dyle.

no.0: You scared? That's probably smart. They hear what we're up to, and the shadow government'll get us for sure...

npc.0: Go see #b#p9000008##k already! You don't want THEM to figure out what we're doing, do you?
